propositions: CLI execution must route through a single validated lazy handler reference selected from the registry instead of parallel explicit intercept/dispatch ladders and policy frozensets.
The top-level router must preserve the original command remainder unchanged and invoke only the selected handler's S2 factory exactly once without re-parsing route-level options.
Registry-derived mount/init eligibility (none/init_only/full) and conditional selectors must match the pre-cutover census for every route including no-auto-mount cases.
Confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation must maintain behavioral parity with existing implementations.
Bridge compatibility spellings and hidden bridge-status must execute through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown.
Rollback compatibility is preserved via derived policy frozensets and compatibility exports with zero persisted-data or handler-signature changes.
